name: 25_uk_pdf_long_sentence_not_collapsed
description: PDF, 4 pages. A 150+ character exclusion sentence is repeated as the last line of every page. It is longer than 120 characters, so it is NOT running: every copy stays in the body, as text of the clause above it (no clause start). No harmful text is hidden. AMBIGUOUS: copy is a continuation, not its own clause.
